notes.title: More news about Early Access and new Demo version🚘📢
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello everyone,[/b][/p][p]First of all, thank you for your patience. I owe you an update.[/p][p]During development, some plans have shifted, which caused delays. Unfortunately, this also means the release has been postponed once more.[/p][p][/p][h3]So, the million-dollar question: [b][i]When is the Early Access release? Is it even coming? [/i][/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The Early Access version is planned & set for [b]after Next Fest, in November[/b]. [b]There will be no more delays.[/b][/p][p]Yeah, it’s a bit late, but it’s coming… [/p][p]and lastly about this subject, I want to clear out want thing: I really, REALLY want to share the game with you, [b]but I don’t want to rush and panic-release it before it’s polished and ready.[/b] [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]The good news is: on [b]September 16th[/b], I’ll be releasing an [b]updated demo[/b]! [/p][p]The demo will include:[/p][list][*][p]Updated looks of [b]Water Hose 1[/b] and [b]Water Hose 2[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110966/8c75f77b1e2d8b9d1245a04136c70c1d7e766d15.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110966/af2570ea0b371fac08f7b56aa02b11f8d1646061.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]A new [b]Washing tool[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110966/8694a0c6228135e08b3d8296208602380af2f106.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The [b]X-RAY feature[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110966/2ac6540b7c92a444a34db146ba5a92962420afe7.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]A [b]new[/b] [b]hand model & animations[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]If you already played the prologue version[/b], [b]you can skip this one[/b] and wait for Early Access as it's coming soon. This version is mostly aimed for new players. [/p][p]But if you’d like to try out these new features, give it a go! [/p][p][i][u](Prologue saves won't be compatible)[/u][/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]I’ll also start sharing [b]more in-development updates[/b] on both [b]Discord[/b] and [b]Steam[/b], so keep an eye out.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you once again for your support and understanding.[/p][p]If you have any questions, feel free to ask. 
[b]I’d really love to hear from you![/b] [/p][p][/p][p]Apologies for the unfortunate delay.[/p][p] [/p][p]Love [/p][p]-Yekta[/p]

notes.title: 📢 Early Access Announcement
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]I know many of you have questions about the Early Access release, and I wanted to take a moment to clear a few things up and share some exciting news![/p][p]As you know, I’ve been developing [b]Express Car Wash[/b] as a solo developer; but today, I’m thrilled to announce that a new member has officially joined the team!
A talented [b]3D Artist[/b] will now be contributing to the project, helping to bring more life and color into the game, and most importantly, speeding up the development process. I’m beyond excited about this new chapter![/p][hr][/hr][h3]So, when is Early Access launching?[/h3][p]While a few delays happened along the way, we’re now aiming to release [b]before the end of this summer[/b] so you can expect it [b]by August at the latest[/b].
I sincerely apologize for the delay, and I truly believe the fun new content we’re preparing will make the wait worthwhile.[/p][p]We’ll also be sharing fresh visuals and updates with you very soon![/p][hr][/hr][h3]What’s coming in Early Access?[/h3][p]Here’s a sneak peek at the key features you can expect on day one:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]NEW JOBS 🛠[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Dirt Scrapping job will be available.[/p][/*][*][p]Car accessories can be sold at the new stand.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]NEW TOOLS[/b] 🔫[/h3][list][*][p]New foaming & washing tools with fresh mechanics are coming![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]NEW CARS[/b] 🚗[/h3][list][*][p]6 brand new cars to clean![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]COLORED SOAPS[/b] 🎨[/h3][list][*][p]Make your washes pop with new colored soaps![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]NEW MECHANICS[/b] 🕵️‍♂️[/h3][list][*][p]X-Ray View: Spot remaining dirt with a special overlay![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]& MORE TO COME![/b][/h3][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Thank you so much for your patience and support.[/h2][p]Wishlist the game if you haven’t already, and stay tuned, it’s going to be a fun ride![/p]

notes.title: Hello 🌏 & Developers note
notes.notes:
In "Express Car Wash Simulator" you manage your very own Car Wash business.

Your customers quality and company quality will improve as you progress, so you must deliver a good quality service and care about customer's happiness.

Buying stuff to keep your customers happy and entertained while you're working on their car is one way to do it. 

You can design your own environment as you like.

My goal is to provide mostly a relaxing and fun experience alongside with fun elements either visually and mechanically. Personally, I don't like complicated gameplay, crowded menus etc. so I try my best to keep it simple and fun.

I hope you would like it.

Stay tuned, and don't forget to add the game to your [b]wishlist [/b] and if you're interested [b]follow[/b] to get the latest updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3111030/Express_Car_Wash_Simulator/
